status: Owner-amended draft expectations recorded before classifier edits; publication and broader-candidate checks remain B1 prerequisites.
expectations: Residential/commercial/industrial gas sales averages retain whole-product status only in the named sector and carry the approved sales-price label across NG, MER and SEDS.

Whole electric-power coal/gas receipt prices may qualify as labelled headline sector averages, with broader published sector total preferred. Survey population restriction alone no longer makes them subset-only.
Electricity operational cost columns can qualify for the electric-power sector when fuel and sector facets are whole; generating-facility prices do not become all-sector economy prices.
Coal mine-origin shipment price is not destination-state sector price; plant-state price preserves its destination scope.
Utility-scale net summer capacity may qualify as labelled headline total where no broader compatible all-size total is published; utility-only/IPP-only ownership components remain narrower.
No history, availability, missing data, geographic restriction, frequency or unit is inferred from this acceptance. Every proposed mapping still needs live B1 checks.

findings.finding: SEDS sector gas prices use onsystem sales from 1987; power prices supplement missing states using other official cost series or geographic estimates. Retain historical source notes and label estimates.
SEDS combines coke/steam for industrial price and fills missing electric-power prices with documented estimates. These are broader candidate sector estimates, not new app calculations.
Fuel receipt/cost scope uses coal-primary plants of at least 50 MW and specified gas/petroleum-primary plants of at least 200 MW. EIA-860 capacity covers facilities of at least 1 MW.
Published coal-cost total includes waste coal and coal-derived synthesis gas; do not silently substitute only a coal rank or ownership group.
